hook.name: GeneralLaunchHook
hook.description: A meme-token launch hook for Uniswap v4 that applies configurable buy/sell taxes and a time-decaying anti-snipe tax during the launch window. Tax proceeds are routed to configurable sinks (burn via buyback-and-burn, holder reflection, auto-LP deepening, creator, and extra wallets). Tracks price-multiple milestones ("Chad Levels") per pool.
